title: Canonical Zeta Selector Principle and Uniqueness Audit
primary_research_question: Which zero-independent axioms, derived from the completed zeta and its prime-side structure, uniquely select a non-scalar arithmetic functional from the otherwise arbitrary kernel space before curvature or spectral positivity is tested?

candidate_selector_audits.selector_name: Uniqueness under the Functional Equation (Hamburger / Burnol Co-Poisson Dictionary)
candidate_selector_audits.governing_zero_independent_axioms: Completed functional equation xi(s) = xi(1 - s) with pi^{-s/2} Gamma(s/2) Archimedean factor, moderate polynomial growth, and S-support / co-Poisson lattice condition on Z.
candidate_selector_audits.unique_object_selected: 1D scalar ray C * zeta(s) (equivalently the integer counting measure sum_{n>=1} delta_n and von Mangoldt log-derivative measure sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) delta_n).
candidate_selector_audits.circularity_or_obstruction_firewall: Certified in 128-bit Arb: tilde{G}_-^inv and tilde{G}_+^inv in C_c^infty((0, infty)^2) are simultaneously nonnegative, permutation-symmetric F(x,y)=F(y,x), and inversion-symmetric F(16/x, 16/y)=F(x,y), yet C_arith(tilde{G}_-^inv) < 0 < C_arith(tilde{G}_+^inv).
primary_literature_references: Hamburger (1921), Math. Z. 10, 240-254
Burnol (2012), Deux extensions de Theoremes de Hamburger, Expos. Math. 30, 295-308, https://arxiv.org/abs/1106.4749v2
Burnol (2007), Entrelacement de co-Poisson, Ann. Inst. Fourier 57(2), 525-602, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0407443v3
Baez-Duarte (2002), A general statement of the functional equation for the Riemann zeta-function, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0207237v1

candidate_selector_audits.selector_name: Jacobi Theta Self-Duality and Canonical Self-Dual Gaussian
candidate_selector_audits.governing_zero_independent_axioms: Fourier self-duality hat{f} = f on R combined with ground-state strict positivity (or oscillator ground-state equation (-d^2/dx^2 + 4*pi^2*x^2) psi_0 = 2*pi*psi_0), inducing theta(1/t) = sqrt(t) theta(t).
candidate_selector_audits.unique_object_selected: Canonical additive Gaussian Theta_1(x, y) = exp(-pi*(x^2 + y^2)) at the unique self-dual scale t = 1 (up to positive scalar).
candidate_selector_audits.circularity_or_obstruction_firewall: Additive-to-multiplicative chain-rule drift (t d/dt)^2 = t^2 d^2/dt^2 + t d/dt gives C_arith(Theta_t) = 4*pi^2*t^2*(M_0*M_2 - M_1^2) - 4*pi*t*M_0*M_1. At t = 1, the negative drift -4*pi*M_0*M_1 dominates the positive Bernstein variance by 5 orders of magnitude (C_arith / A_0^2 ~ -100.5305 ~ -32*pi < 0, certified in 128-bit Arb).
primary_literature_references: Riemann (1859), Monatsber. Berlin Akad., 671-680
Edwards (1974), Riemann's Zeta Function, Academic Press
Burnol (2004), Two complete and minimal systems associated with the zeros of the Riemann zeta function, J. Theor. Nombres Bordeaux 16, 65-94, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0203120v7

candidate_selector_audits.selector_name: Prime/Archimedean Explicit-Formula Balance and Conductor Operator
candidate_selector_audits.governing_zero_independent_axioms: Weil explicit-formula distributional equality between prime-power von Mangoldt stations, the Archimedean Gamma distribution, and the dilaton-invariant conductor operator log|x| + log|y|.
candidate_selector_audits.unique_object_selected: The global Weil explicit-formula linear functional W_zeta in D'(R_{>0}) (universal identity across all admissible test functions, not a single test kernel).
candidate_selector_audits.circularity_or_obstruction_firewall: By TASK-TC-032R (`exact_cancellation_precludes_strict_subordination`), whenever support separation forces the arithmetic functional Q_eps = 0 identically, the omitted spectral/Archimedean complement R_eps = -D_eps cancels the selected block exactly rather than isolating a positive definite zero sum.
primary_literature_references: Weil (1952), Sur les 'formules explicites' de la theorie des nombres premiers, Comm. Sem. Math. Univ. Lund, 252-265
Burnol (2000), Sur les Formules Explicites I: analyse invariante, C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris 331, 423-428, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0101068v1

candidate_selector_audits.selector_name: Extremal and Variational Principles (Nyman-Beurling-Baez-Duarte, Li, Suzuki)
candidate_selector_audits.governing_zero_independent_axioms: Strict L^2 projection convexity d_N^2 = inf ||chi_{(0,1)} - sum_{k=1}^N c_k {1/(kx)}||^2 (Nyman-Beurling-Baez-Duarte), canonical rational test basis phi_n(s) = 1 - (1 - 1/s)^n (Li / Lagarias), or localized Rayleigh quotient minimization lambda_1(R) (Suzuki).
candidate_selector_audits.unique_object_selected: For each fixed complexity/window parameter N or R, selects a unique finite-stage extremal vector f_N^* and value d_N^2 (or lambda_n, lambda_1(R)).
candidate_selector_audits.circularity_or_obstruction_firewall: At any single finite N, d_N^2 > 0 holds unconditionally whether or not RH holds; excluding delta_rho != 0 requires lim_{N->infty} d_N = 0 (or forall n, lambda_n >= 0; forall R, lambda_1(R) >= 0), which is a known RH-equivalent criterion, and Mellin grade dilation D_K is an L^2 isometry (`PURE_COORDINATE_RESCALING_NO_GAIN`).
primary_literature_references: Baez-Duarte (2003), A new necessary and sufficient condition for the Riemann hypothesis, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0307215v1
Burnol (2003), On an analytic estimate in the theory of the Riemann Zeta function and a Theorem of Baez-Duarte, Acta Cient. Venez. 54, 210-215, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0202166v1
Lagarias (2007), Li Coefficients for Automorphic L-Functions, Ann. Inst. Fourier 57, 1689-1740, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0404394v4
Suzuki (2026), Lowest eigenvalues of localized Weil operators, https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09096v3

candidate_selector_audits.selector_name: Canonical Operator Trace (Connes-Consani Semi-Local Trace and Sonin Compression)
candidate_selector_audits.governing_zero_independent_axioms: Compression of the multiplicative scaling action onto the orthogonal complement of phase-space cutoff projections (Sonin space, cutoff parameter Lambda = 1) and expansion via prolate spheroidal wave functions.
candidate_selector_audits.unique_object_selected: Canonical compressed scaling trace Tr_Sonin at the Archimedean place and semi-local trace functional over the adele class / scaling site.
candidate_selector_audits.circularity_or_obstruction_firewall: In Connes-Consani (2020, 2021), positivity of the compressed scaling trace holds at the single Archimedean place via prolate/Toeplitz control, whereas in the general semi-local case including prime places, global positivity of the Weil functional remains equivalent to RH (`CURVATURE_POSITIVITY_IS_RH_EQUIVALENT`).
primary_literature_references: Connes & Consani (2020), Weil positivity and Trace formula, the archimedean place, https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.13771v1
Connes & Consani (2021), Spectral Triples and Zeta-Cycles, https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.01715v1
Connes & Consani (2021), BC-system, absolute cyclotomy and the quantized calculus, https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.08820v1
Burnol (2001), Sur certains espaces de Hilbert de fonctions entieres (Sonine spaces), C. R. Acad. Sci. Paris 333, 201-206, https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0105120v1

candidate_selector_audits.selector_name: Functorial and Multi-Grade Naturality Stronger than Ordinary Rescaling
candidate_selector_audits.governing_zero_independent_axioms: Multi-grade fiber isomorphism naturality F_K ~= F_J with exact 1-coboundary transitions c(J, K) = tau^{J-K}, strengthened to infinitesimal Euler scale homogeneity E F_0 = d F_0.
candidate_selector_audits.unique_object_selected: Under ordinary transfer naturality: uniquely selects b = 1 (leaving F_0 arbitrary). Under strengthened Euler homogeneity E F_0 = d F_0 on C_c^infty((0, infty)^2): uniquely selects the zero kernel F_0 == 0.
candidate_selector_audits.circularity_or_obstruction_firewall: By TASK-TC-027 (`MULTIGRADE_NATURALITY_NO_GO_PROVED`), TASK-TC-033 (`TRANSPORT_MOMENT_INCOMPATIBILITY_PROVED`), and TASK-TC-034R (`COMPACT_SUPPORT_HOMOGENEITY_NO_GO_PAPER_PROVED`), ordinary naturality leaves F_0 unselected while Euler homogeneity E F_0 = d F_0 forces F_0 == 0 on compact support.
primary_literature_references: TASK-TC-027 (formal/RiemannScope/MultiGradeNaturality.lean)
TASK-TC-033 (formal/RiemannScope/GradeHankelConstraint.lean)
TASK-TC-034R (formal/RiemannScope/TransportMismatchCurvature.lean, docs/reviews/TC_034R_TRANSPORT_MISMATCH_CURVATURE_REPAIR_AUDIT.md)

branch_1_scale_homogeneous_flatness.obstruction: Only F_0 == 0 lies in C_c^infty((0, infty)^2) (COMPACT_SUPPORT_HOMOGENEITY_NO_GO_PAPER_PROVED); noncompact homogeneous powers do not converge across the critical strip.

branch_2_classical_symmetry_or_theta_sel.condition: Permutation symmetry F(x,y)=F(y,x), multiplicative inversion symmetry F(c_0^2/x, c_0^2/y)=F(x,y), or Fourier/theta self-duality hat{f}=f
branch_2_classical_symmetry_or_theta_sel.arithmetic_curvature_consequence: Inversion+permutation-symmetric compact kernels remain Arb-certified sign-indefinite; the canonical self-dual Gaussian Theta_1 has Arb-certified C_arith(Theta_1) < 0 due to the additive-to-multiplicative chain-rule drift -4*pi*M_0*M_1.
branch_2_classical_symmetry_or_theta_sel.obstruction: By Lean theorem `selector_trilemma_algebraic_dichotomy`, C_arith <= 0 and C_arith = S_diag + R_comp with S_diag > 0 merely implies R_comp < 0 unless R_comp >= 0 is independently proved (`selector_trilemma_contradiction_of_nonneg_complement`, OBL-CT-001A).

branch_3_variational_or_semi_local_trace.condition: Nyman-Beurling L^2 projection sequence d_N^2, Li rational basis lambda_n, Suzuki localized Rayleigh minimum lambda_1(R), or Connes-Consani semi-local trace
branch_3_variational_or_semi_local_trace.arithmetic_curvature_consequence: Selects a canonical indexed sequence or semi-local trace functional rather than a single finite kernel.
branch_3_variational_or_semi_local_trace.obstruction: Each individual finite stage is strictly positive unconditionally; critical-line zero confinement holds only in the infinite asymptotic limit or global trace positivity, which is RH-equivalent.

hypothesis_fidelity.tc_hypothesis: The same arithmetic object across transcendental grades implies a constraint.
hypothesis_fidelity.selector_audit_finding: Standard zero-independent zeta axioms (functional equation, theta self-duality, explicit-formula balance, finite-stage variational projections, semi-local trace compression, and multi-grade coboundary naturality) either select the distribution W_zeta while leaving the test kernel sign-indefinite, select the additive Gaussian Theta_1 whose multiplicative Euler curvature is strictly negative by chain-rule drift, or select an infinite family whose positivity is RH-equivalent.
hypothesis_fidelity.distinction: Absence of a single-kernel curvature selector among standard zero-independent structures refutes naive single-kernel selector implementations, NOT the general TC hypothesis; OBL-CT-001A remains OPEN.
